# Wait for a page that is slow to finish

`isLoaded()` already waits for the URL, the page load, the title and the key headings. For a spinner or
a late third-party widget, add proof to the page's **load-checks** YOURS block:

```ts
    WaitActions.forInvisibilityOf(DynamicLoadingDetailElements.LOADING_SPINNER, `${this.name} did not load! LOADING_SPINNER never went away!`);
    WaitActions.forVisibilityOf(DynamicLoadingDetailElements.PAYMENT_FRAME, `${this.name} did not load! PAYMENT_FRAME did not show within 15 s!`, 15000);
```

Wait for the last thing to arrive, and for the spinner to go, not for time to pass. Everything slow on
this site: raise `pageLoadTimeout` / `defaultCommandTimeout` in cypress.config.ts (its settings block).
